text: Every trend cycle, the senior team spent two to three weeks on research. Twenty sources, checked by hand.
So we built the Trend Intelligence Platform.
It monitors over a thousand sources, and drafts the trend report for the team to refine.
Open any trend, and the evidence is right there, with what it doesn't prove yet. Pick the ones worth pursuing.
And it turns them into an opportunity brief. Product concepts, and the questions to test with buyers.
Weeks of research, now under four hours. So senior time goes back on strategy and clients.
